gloss_en: Perfection/completeness of speech (שְׁלֵמוּת הַדִּבּוּר) identified with the Holy Tongue (לְשׁוֹן הַקֹּדֶשׁ) in Torah lm2:2 — the wholeness of the faculty of speech attained through the one complete language, contrasted with the deficient 'stammering' tongues of the nations, linked to Shabbat-speech and serving as the means to draw Shabbat's joy into the six weekdays; construct head is שלמות הדבור (speech), not שלמות לשון הקדש of lm1:19
